result.name: facade_west.png
result.panel_note: Left is the untouched original crop. Right is an exact color-distance mask: magenta outlines candidate bands; blue marks only actual support at the peak coordinate. Marks are coordinate references, not entities. Right-panel local coordinates correspond to the same original crop after removing its combined-image offset.
result.evidence_note: Support intervals are measured only at each candidate peak. They do not prove a whole band is continuous or identify a wall. Filtered or empty results do not prove an object is absent.
result.display_note: For a returned-image point (rx, ry), first multiply by original_pixels_per_returned_pixel to obtain full combined-image coordinates (fx, fy). On the left, original image coordinates are (box_left + fx, box_top + fy). On the right, subtract mask_panel_combined_pixels[0] from fx before adding box_left. Prefer candidates and support intervals, which already use original-image coordinates.

source_geometry_self_consistency.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

agent_assumptions: Local 15-degree frame per declaration; facade names are local axes, not geographic.
8 above-ground storeys: ground commercial (4.2m) + 6 office floors (3.6m) + setback penthouse (4.0m); floor-to-floor inferred from facade_west window bands and ~26m main roofline.
L-shaped footprint derived from developer facade planes: west wing x[-13.7,0.7] y[-33.4,26.1] and NE block x[0.7,18.9] y[9.1,26.1].
Low 2-storey annex fills part of courtyard: x[0.7,13] y[-21.5,9.1] (overview_top tan roof, facade_annex_east).
All interior partitions, corridors, core, room uses and doors are explicit hypotheses; no interior evidence supplied.
Setback penthouse footprint is a simplified inferred setback over the NE block.
unresolved: Exact storey/slab heights not surveyed; derived from facade pixels.
Setback penthouse true plan extent and whether it also covers the west wing north end.
Ground-level entrance inventory (only hypothetical entrances modelled).
Court-facade (x=0.7) window extent on floors overlapping annex not fully modelled.
Occluded ground floor on north/courtyard sides (missing mesh); annex-to-wing internal connection not modelled.
